|---|---|
| D01 | Versioned /admin/v1 resources, different admin envelopes/verbs/pagination and page locations |
| D02 | Listen :21128; /health/live and /health/ready; plain text health |
| D03 | Client key digest/prefix and create-once secret, sealed provider credentials; no browser credential reads |
| D04 | Go service/static React-Vite, own admin KDF/opaque session, no Next/JWT runtime or machine-token dependency |
| D05 | No standalone image/video/TTS/STT/embedding/media-provider product APIs/catalogs |
| D06 | trae, devin-cli, windsurf absent |
| D07 | One Generic Provider can advertise C/R/M instead of separate compatible node products |
| D08 | Independent normalized SQLite schema/files/backup artifacts, no direct LiteRouter DB compatibility |
| D09 | One SSE event channel, targeted invalidation, refresh fallback |
| D10 | Typed/validated string settings and normalized adapters/models; final-body cache order; PRD's 5 MB detail target |
| D11 | Explicit CORS allowlist, strict SSRF/private-network policy, trusted local opt-in, no forwarded-header blind trust |
| D12 | No cloud sync, tunnel/Tailscale/MITM lifecycle, removed legacy platform state |
| D13 | No Redis/Postgres/remote cache bus/multi-replica topology; immutable snapshots + separate mutable state, pooled transports, bounded async telemetry |

## Not covered by the differential

- the response legs whose upstream is a binary wire: Kiro (EventStream), Cursor, Command Code;
- non-streaming response bodies (the oracle converts streams only; Routeweft's buffered conversions are tested against its own expectations);
- control workflows other than combos, API keys and model aliases (provider nodes, connections, settings, pricing, usage), beyond the route inventory (`compat/parity/inventory.mjs`) and the pool and pricing pins;
- anything that needs a live provider.
